title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Cassette > Digitized 24/48 > Sound Forge 7 > CD Wave > Flac 16
source: Nak 700s > Bass Box > Cassette (19th row center FOB/DFC 7' up)

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording that captures a solid performance, regarded as the best available source for this show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the audio quality, calling it the best sounding version of the available tapes and noting the venue sounded very good. The concert itself is described as a fine, quite good show, making the release enjoyable both sonically and musically.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight excellent sound quality and a good performance, yielding an overall rating of four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best sounding among available sources; great clarity and venue acoustics, with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance noted as quite good throughout, with no specific issues mentioned.
